comments.text: On 21/12/25, this bus company CUONG TUYET, drove away with our luggage on Vietnam-Laos border, 3 suitcases and 3 backpacks were stolen and we left with nothing. They did it on purpose because there were 3 staff in the bus, there weren't many passengers in bus so they couldn't miss us also we were the only 3 white people. The reason we got our luggage back is because we had a picture of the bus and it's plate number. So we talked to the border police who called them and made us sit on another bus to chase them to get our luggage back. So we got our luggage back but we will publish this theft so people don't go to Laos because it is not safe there as bus company's steal from you your stuff. We were warned by many people about different incidents before to not go to Laos but we didn't listen. Laos doesn't deserve tourists, they only steal from them. https://www.youtube.com/shorts/KTvsHaKsSQc
